pages.title: YunLai Swordmanship
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Swords$(br2)§lEffect: §r Attack Speed +2.5, Attack Reach +2.5 blocks, Damage ×1.10; hits have a 60% chance to launch a light-blue sword-qi, with Damage ×0.5 and a 6-block range.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with Ancient YunLai Swordmanship and other melee damage/growth-type enchantments; only one may be applied to a weapon.
